messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick check-in 10 on marketplace launch readiness for Tue. Can each owner confirm: press embargo, blog + assets, marketplace listing content, SI integration blurb, landing page, and partner logos?
Eli (Marketing): Press embargo cleared by comms; embargo memo sent. Blog draft at 92% 1need final screenshots + OG image.
Gwen (Product): SI integration copy done. Still waiting for final HW partner supported SKU list for the technical note.
Jess (Partner Ops): HW SKUs inbound today from partner. Marketplace listing for GCP/Azure pending final pricing table from Finance (cc: @Eli).
Sam (Eng): Landing page load perf verified in staging. CDN TTLs configured. Need two hero images (desktop + mobile) and icon sprites from design.
Eli (Marketing): I'll export hero variants and drop links in this thread by EOD. Using sandbox keys in examples.
DesignBot: Uploaded hero_desktop_v3.png and hero_mobile_v3.png to /assets/tmp; sharing links: https://cdn.redwood.ai/tmp/hero_desktop_v3.png , https://cdn.redwood.ai/tmp/hero_mobile_v3.png
Gwen (Product): Thanks 1esign looks good. Also want a small note on landing: "Dedicated customers can opt into fallback model variants during heavy load" 1add to copy?
Sam (Eng): Yes include that. Also snippet for the routing demo uses new header. Example (use sandbox key): curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_SANDBOX_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Eli (Marketing): Copy-paste that snippet into the blog's code block and ensure no real keys.
Ravi (Legal): Joint announcement language needs one tweak around SI credentialing. I commented in the draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/announce/draft (see section 3).
Maya (Partnerships): Owner map: Marketing = Eli (blog + press), Product = Gwen (SI + technical notes), Partner Ops = Jess (partner approvals + logos), Eng = Sam (landing + demos), Legal = Ravi (signoff). Call out blockers now.
Jess (Partner Ops): Blocker: one HW partner requires logo approval from their comms team; ETA ~24 hours. We can ship with placeholder text "in collaboration with our hardware partners" if logo delayed.
Eli (Marketing): Neutral line approved: "in collaboration with our hardware partners" works for the content plan.
Ravi (Legal): That phrasing OK. Keep logo out until formal sign-off.
Gwen (Product): Rehearsal: propose 15-min dry run Mon at 16:00 PT with comms, SI reps, and HW partner rep to test CTA flows and the marketplace purchase button.
Maya (Partnerships): Agreed. @Jess please invite SI and HW comms. Eli to run press timeline rehearsal.
Jess (Partner Ops): Invite sent to SI reps and partner comms.
Sam (Eng): Cutover smoke checklist (suggested): - Verify marketplace listing URLs - Test purchase flow in sandbox (both free trial and paid) - Validate CDN assets and hero images - Ensure fallback model route is reachable - Confirm monitoring alerts fire in staging - Sanity-check rate limit headers
Eli (Marketing): Add: verify open graph metadata + Twitter card + amp analytics tagging for syndicated blog.
Maya (Partnerships): Final asks: drop final hero images, pricing table from Finance, and HW logo decision by EOD tomorrow. If all green we proceed with embargo lift as scheduled. Thanks team! :tada:
